name: Monetary tightening
assumption: Illustrative parallel USD curve shock, not a prediction or the observed policy move.

name: Monetary easing
assumption: Illustrative parallel USD curve shock; easing can produce gains as well as losses.

name: Corporate credit deterioration
assumption: Spread widening on matched corporate issuers; sector matching only when no issuer is identified. No recovery/default-loss overlay.

name: Geopolitical supply disruption
assumption: Analyst-defined adverse USD rate shock and spread widening only for explicitly affected energy/transport cash positions. Not applicable to all geopolitical events.
